title: NFT Showcases
tagline: A dapp where you can see all NFTs from wallet address in different networks.
description: This dapp allows users to views their NFTs in different network when they enter their address and select the network such as Ethereum, Polygon (Matic), Avalanche, and Binance Smart Chain.  They can view the contract of the NFT such as floor price, unique token ids sold today, gas quote rate day, and list of NFTs minted.
how_its_made:
The front end is build with React and Ant Design for styling of the Dapp. 



I used the following technologies:

- NFTPort: It uses NFTPort API to get all NFTs minted by contract

- Covalent:  It uses Covalent API to fetch NFTs metadata from user wallet and historical data for NFT collection
